<a id="forgot_your_name"></a>
## Sitcom Theme: `forgot_your_name.yml`

A warm sitcom theme in the manner of Cheers, with a melody of its own on clarinet, over a piano
comping on the beats, a bass and soft drums.

## Creepy Harpsichord Theme: `mysterious_spooky.yml`

A playful theme in the manner of The Addams Family, with a tune of its own: a harpsichord creeping
up in half steps, finger snaps on two and four, a tuba bass and a church organ.

<a id="not_painless"></a>
## Wistful Guitar Theme: `not_painless.yml`

A gentle theme in the manner of M*A*S*H, with a melody of its own on flute: a nylon guitar picks its
chords through an arpeggiator, round the circle of fifths in minor.

<a id="phoenix_foundation"></a>
## Action-Show Theme: `phoenix_foundation.yml`

A mid-eighties action-show theme in the manner of MacGyver, with a melody of its own on synth brass,
over rock guitar, a pulsing synth bass and keys broken into sixteenths over two octaves by an
arpeggiator.

<a id="sax_reindeer"></a>
## Novelty Saxophone Romp: `sax_reindeer.yml`

A breakneck romp in the manner of Yakety Sax: a tenor saxophone running in sixteenths over a honky-
tonk piano, an oom-pah bass and a two-beat kit, with every run its own.

<a id="spy_hunting"></a>
## Spy Theme: `spy_hunting.yml`

A late-fifties spy theme in the manner of Peter Gunn: a low guitar riff doubled by the bass, a surf
beat, brass stabs and a tenor saxophone, every scene one chorus of a minor twelve-bar blues from a
Progression. The riff and the tune are its own.

<a id="uphill_cops"></a>
## Voice-Led Piano Theme: `uphill_cops.yml`

A gentle theme in the manner of Hill Street Blues, with a melody of its own on solo piano. The
chords come from a Progression and then a Voice leading generator, which voices each chord nearest
the one before, so that the chords glide.
